messages:
Mira (Product): dropped a compact mock of the Audit > Export flow. Need quick UX + security + a11y sweep.
Sam (Design): quick skim. overall OK. tiny ask: change 'Presets' label 12 to something more discoverable like 'Saved views' or 'Filters'.
Matt (Eng): heads up: csv headers are currently `timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days`. If we rename UI labels, some customers' parsers will break. Suggest emitting a small `export_manifest.json` alongside exports with header mappings.
Elaine (Security): request: if export contains any KMS key IDs or aliases, surface a clear caution: "This export contains key metadata. Confirm the destination meets your organization's export and retention controls." Also record an audit event when users opt in.
Aria (A11y): accessibility nits: 1) filter pills need `role=button` and `aria-pressed`; 2) saved-views menu must support arrow-key navigation; 3) when export starts announce "Export started" and progress via `aria-live=polite`.
Sam (Design): visual nit: the KMS lock dot (12px purple) is ambiguous and tooltip text has poor contrast. Options: add an inline 'KMS' label, increase badge size, or switch tooltip to high-contrast. I prefer inline text for clarity.
Mira (Product): agree on inline label. Also rename retention label to 'Retention period' in UI (backend keeps `retention_days`).
Matt (Eng): implementation plan: add `export_manifest.json` with `export_version`, `headers`, `header_aliases`. Add opt-in checkbox 'Include key metadata' (default OFF). For enterprise orgs gate a typed confirmation: `I understand this export contains key metadata`.
Elaine (Security): +1. Typed confirm required for enterprise. Link to export guidance doc from the modal.
Aria (A11y): modal checklist: focus trap, initial focus on typed field, `aria-describedby` linking to security copy, and SR-friendly error messages.
Sam (Design): microcopy: button states `Download CSV` / `Download CSV (includes key metadata)`. Tooltip: `Includes audit fields; only include key metadata if necessary.`
Matt (Eng): dev note: header aliases so UI label changes don't break CSV consumers. ETA: end of week for PR review.
opsbot: deploy-preview created for branch `feature/audit-export-clarity`  http://preview/redwood/exp-901 (auto)
Mira (Product): owners: Matt (backend), Sam (visuals + copy), Aria (a11y sign-off), Elaine (security copy). I'll file PR checklist and land the microcopy tomorrow unless objections.
